title: Keep MCP discovery warnings independent of upstream error text
answers: What should the warning say when an MCP server cannot list tools?
Can tool discovery toasts display Error.message?
Why use fixed recovery text for an added server with no tools?
body:
Invariant: Tool-discovery warning toasts must use fixed recovery text rather than the upstream error reason.
Enforcement: products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useGatewayServers.ts:DISCOVERY_FAILED and products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:DISCOVERY_FAILED supply context-specific "Connected" or "Added" messages directing the user to open the server and retry.
Failure if skipped: The refresh endpoint's detail can contain fragments of the upstream server's response body, so rendering that reason in a toast can expose upstream content.
applies: User-facing warnings for failed Desktop MCP gateway tool listing.
